answer: An AI-agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using decentralized latency triangulation. Peer nodes whisper timing probes to verify that delays match physical distances, forbidding audit traffic to wander across spoofed proxy pools. This forces an attacker to incur scarce, geographically unique transit costs per identity. An identity decays into an inert ember if verification heartbeats cease. However, unpredictable routing fluctuations can penalize legitimate agents.
